hero.subtitle: Software engineer and PhD in mechanics. I build applications that put data to work, from data modelling through to production, and I stay close to the people who use them every day.

about.p1: I’ve worked on projects in France and the United Kingdom. Different teams, cultures and ways of working taught me to read the context before proposing anything, and to adapt rather than apply a ready-made recipe.
about.p2: To me, good software is measured by the time it saves the people who use it, not by how sophisticated it is under the hood.
about.p3: That’s what drives my technical choices: I’d rather ship the solution a team can keep alive after I’m gone than the one that looks most impressive today.

research.meta_desc: Peer-reviewed scientific publications: mechanics, wave propagation and numerical modelling applied to underground structures.
research.lead: Before software engineering, there was research.
research.intro_1: My doctorate tackled a demanding engineering problem: predicting how underground structures (tunnels, cavities) respond to mechanical and seismic waves. It bears directly on how such infrastructure is designed and kept safe.
research.intro_2: This work combines continuum mechanics, wave propagation, mathematical modelling and numerical methods. It taught me to break a complex problem down, model it rigorously, solve it, then test my results against measurements: habits I still rely on every day in software engineering.
research.impact_lead: Research was not a detour in my career: it is the foundation of how I work.
research.impact_1_d: Break down an ill-posed problem, frame it, then solve it methodically.
research.impact_2_d: Turn a real problem into a workable model without losing the underlying physics.
research.impact_3_d: Think in terms of cost, accuracy and convergence before writing a single line.
research.impact_4_d: Explicit assumptions, reproducible results, verifiable conclusions.
research.impact_5_d: Work with large volumes of data and extract the signal that matters.
research.impact_6_d: Systematically test the model against measurements, and distrust both.
research.impact_7_d: Make a complex idea clear to a non-specialist audience.
research.impact_8_d: Sustain demanding, self-directed work over several years and see it through.
